scope: every variety generated by a semigroup of order at most six
rule: V[n,k] is the variety generated by the semigroup [n,k] = SmallSemigroup(n,k) of GAP Smallsemi, and V[n,k]^op the variety generated by its opposite semigroup, with the transposed table. A variety is named after the least triple (n,k,o) whose semigroup generates it, o = 0 for [n,k] and o = 1 for its opposite, triples compared by n, then by k, then by o. Names never change.
tables: MultiplicationTable(SmallSemigroup(n,k)) of Smallsemi 0.7.2, elements numbered from 1: row i, column j holds the product of the elements i and j

fields.varieties: the names in their order, the order of their triples; for each, the triple of its generator, the name of its dual, whether it has a finite basis, and the table of its generator (transposed when o = 1)
fields.semigroups: for every semigroup [n,k] of order at most six, keyed n-k: the names of the varieties generated by its table and by the transposed table
fields.legacy: the names V[k] of the first release (2 October 2026), after the least generator of order six among the Smallsemi tables, with the names that replace them
